div.div:
R1 · center_and_stretch
Square = longest subject-bbox side × (1 + R1_MARGIN 4.2%). A bled edge is pinned; the slack goes to the free sides. Background bands stretch outward, horizontal pass then vertical — that is what fills the corners. Empty mask, or pins no square can respect → R3
